name: Asana
description_en:
Asana is a collaborative work-management service built around projects and actionable tasks. A project groups an initiative or an ongoing workflow; tasks record the work, owner and due date, and subtasks divide larger pieces. The useful outcome is a shared account of who is responsible for each deliverable, with discussion attached to the work.

A distinctive model is multi-homing: the same task can appear in several projects without becoming several copies. This helps a launch team and a specialist team follow the same item, but it also affects permissions. This profile focuses on the core work-management model, paid automation and AI usage boundaries, rather than assuming every product shown in Asana’s navigation is part of one plan.
description_zh:
Asana 是以项目和可执行任务为基础的协作工作管理服务。项目组织一项举措或持续工作流；任务记录工作内容、负责人和截止日期，子任务进一步拆分较大的工作。其价值在于共同维护每项交付物由谁负责，并将讨论放在工作记录旁。

一个有辨识度的模型是 multi-homing：同一任务可以同时出现在多个项目中，而不是创建多份副本。这能让发布团队和专业团队跟踪同一事项，也会影响权限。本文重点研究核心工作管理、付费自动化和 AI 用量边界，不假定 Asana 导航中出现的所有产品都包含在同一套餐中。

core_features.explanation_en: Each task has one assignee while collaborators can follow the work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 每项任务有一位负责人，协作者可以跟进工作。

core_features.explanation_en: One task can appear in several projects without duplication.
core_features.explanation_zh: 同一任务可以出现在多个项目中，无需复制。

core_features.explanation_en: Paid automations act on configured events with documented project and subtask limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 付费自动化按已配置事件执行，并受文档所列项目和子任务限制。

en: Coordinate a website launch with one owner per deliverable.
Track the same design deliverable in both a launch and specialist project.
zh: 协调网站发布，为每项交付物指定一位负责人。
在发布项目和专业项目中跟踪同一设计交付物。

Task identity.en: Multi-homing reuses one task record across projects.
Task identity.zh: 多项目归属在不同项目中复用同一任务记录。

steps.en: Create one project with stage sections and actionable tasks, then assign owners and dates.
steps.zh: 创建一个有阶段分区和可执行任务的项目，再设置负责人和日期。

steps.en: Verify a shared task with participants who have different project permissions.
steps.zh: 使用项目权限不同的参与者验证一条共享任务。

integrations.scope: External automation actions use creator credentials; individual connector mapping and recovery were not verified.

items.zh: 一项任务只有一位负责人。

items.en: Multi-homed permissions can be higher than the rights in one individual project.
items.zh: 多项目任务的权限可能高于某个单独项目中的权限。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Personal 两用户免费。付费套餐按用户计费，年付和月付费率不同。

sections.title_en: Turn an initiative into accountable tasks
sections.title_zh: 把举措拆成有负责人的任务
sections.en:
For a hypothetical website launch, create a launch project and separate tasks for copy, design review and publication. Each task has one assignee; other people can collaborate through comments and notifications. If several people must contribute distinct steps, use subtasks or separate deliverable tasks instead of expecting multiple owners on one task.

Before inviting everyone, define what makes each item complete and put supporting context in its description. Review the project with the intended assignees. This example demonstrates a possible data model, not a launch executed in this research.
sections.zh:
假设要发布一个网站，可以创建发布项目，再分别创建文案、设计审阅和发布任务。每项任务只有一位负责人，其他人通过评论和通知参与。如果多人分别承担不同步骤，应使用子任务或独立交付任务，而不是期待一项任务有多位负责人。

邀请整个团队前，应定义每个事项的完成条件，并在描述中补充背景。建议与预期受派人员一起检查项目。这个示例解释一种可行的数据模型，不是本次研究实际执行过的网站发布。

sections.title_en: One task in two projects is still one task
sections.title_zh: 两个项目中的同一任务仍是一个对象
sections.en:
A launch task can also be added to a design-team project through the Projects field. The original project retains it, and edits to the assignee, date or description affect the same task in every associated project. Multi-homing is therefore different from copying a task and synchronizing two independent records.

Use this when both teams need the same deliverable, not when they need different completion criteria. During a pilot, edit the due date from each view and verify that participants understand they are changing shared work. This is a proposed acceptance check, not an observed product test.
sections.zh:
发布任务可以通过 Projects 字段加入设计团队项目，原项目仍保留该任务。修改负责人、日期或描述，会影响所有关联项目中的同一对象。因此，multi-homing 与复制任务再同步两条独立记录不同。

当两个团队需要跟踪同一交付物时，可考虑这种方式；若双方完成条件不同，应先重新定义任务。试点时可以分别从两个视图修改截止日期，确认参与者理解自己正在修改共享工作。这是建议的验收检查，并非已执行的产品测试。

sections.title_en: The least permissive project does not always win
sections.title_zh: 权限并非总以最严格项目为准
sections.en:
Asana documents that a multi-homed task uses the highest permission level available across its projects. A person who is a viewer in one project and an editor in another can edit the shared task. Assigned-task elevation can also grant extra abilities while someone is the assignee.

Do not add a sensitive task to another project solely to make a dashboard more convenient. First inspect who belongs to that project and what they can do. Verify with representative participants, because a project’s label alone does not establish the final rights on every shared task.
sections.zh:
Asana 文档说明，多项目任务采用各项目中可获得的最高权限。一位用户在某项目是查看者、在另一项目是编辑者时，可以编辑双方共享的任务。用户被分派任务后，也可能在担任负责人期间获得额外能力。

不要仅为方便看板展示，就把敏感任务加到另一个项目。应先检查该项目的成员和权限，并使用有代表性的参与者验证，因为项目标签本身不能确定每条共享任务的最终权限。

sections.title_en: Triggers, actions and a concrete failure case
sections.title_zh: 触发、动作与具体失败情况
sections.en:
The current help body calls the feature Automations while retaining a rules URL. A trigger can cause an action, such as assigning a task after a due date is set. Documentation limits a project to 50 automations and a custom automation to 20 triggers and 20 actions. Subtask execution covers the first level only; edits apply prospectively.

If an automation moves completed work into a section and that section is deleted, the owner receives an email on the first failed trigger. Repeated emails are not sent until the configuration has been fixed and run successfully before breaking again. Inspect the automation status rather than treating silence as proof of success.
sections.zh:
当前帮助正文将功能称为 Automations，但网址仍使用 rules。触发条件可以带来动作，例如设置截止日期后自动分派任务。文档限定每项目最多 50 条自动化，每条自定义自动化最多 20 个触发器和 20 个动作。子任务执行只覆盖第一层，编辑只对之后的执行生效。

如果自动化要把已完成工作移动到某分区，而该分区被删除，负责人会在首次触发失败时收到邮件。修复且成功执行后再次出错之前，不会反复发送同类邮件。因此，应检查自动化状态，不能把没有邮件当作成功证据。

sections.title_en: Read the free and paid boundaries together
sections.title_zh: 一起看免费与付费边界
sections.en:
The current Personal plan permits two users and lists free ongoing use, with list, board and calendar views. Starter is advertised at USD 10.99 per user per month billed annually, or USD 13.49 billed monthly. Advanced lists USD 24.99 annually billed or USD 30.49 monthly billed, per user per month; Enterprise uses sales pricing. Forms, custom fields and timeline/Gantt appear under Starter, while portfolio management and approvals appear under Advanced.

These are dated public rates, not a quote. Confirm the purchased seat quantity, billing period and applicable taxes before comparing total spend.
sections.zh:
当前 Personal 套餐支持两位用户持续免费使用，列出列表、看板和日历视图。Starter 按年付款时标为每用户每月 10.99 美元，按月付款为 13.49 美元。Advanced 对应为每用户每月 24.99 美元和 30.49 美元；Enterprise 需询价。表单、自定义字段和时间线／甘特图列于 Starter，项目组合管理和审批列于 Advanced。

这些是带读取日期的公开费率，不是报价。比较总支出前，应确认购买席位数、付款周期和适用税费。

sections.title_en: AI requests are a separate usage resource
sections.title_zh: AI 请求是单独的用量资源
sections.en:
The AI usage article describes an organization-level pool shared by AI Teammates and Asana Dash. Included requests refresh monthly and do not roll over. It lists five requests per user monthly with organization caps of 50 on Starter/Advanced and 250 on Enterprise/Enterprise+. Admins should check the live console for the actual allocation.

If included capacity is exhausted without prepaid capacity or activated on-demand billing, the documented functions pause until capacity returns or more is purchased. Do not equate unlimited ordinary automations on a pricing card with unlimited AI work. Output correctness and real usage were not tested here.
sections.zh:
AI 用量文档说明，AI Teammates 和 Asana Dash 共享组织级请求池。包含的请求每月刷新，不结转。文档列出每用户每月五次请求，Starter／Advanced 的组织上限为 50，Enterprise／Enterprise+ 为 250；管理员应在实际控制台确认当前配额。

若包含的容量耗尽，又没有预付容量或启用按需计费，文档所述功能会暂停，直到配额恢复或购买更多容量。定价卡片上的普通自动化不限量，不等于 AI 工作不限量。本次没有测试输出准确性或实际用量。

sections.title_zh: 推广前做一次聚焦评估
sections.en:
Create one real project, add sections representing its stages, assign a small set of tasks and use My tasks to inspect individual responsibility. The quick-start guide emphasizes these basic objects before more elaborate configuration. Include an incomplete item and a changed deadline in the pilot so that the team agrees how updates should be handled.

As an editorial fit judgment, Asana merits investigation when teams need shared ownership and cross-project visibility. A team requiring exact approval or confidentiality behavior should validate those paths under its intended plan. Account creation, integrations, notification timing, offline behavior and contractual hosting rights were not tested or established in this profile.
sections.zh:
创建一个真实项目，用分区表示阶段，分派少量任务，再通过 My tasks 检查个人责任。快速入门指南强调先理解这些基础对象，再进行复杂配置。试点应包括一项未完成工作和一次截止日期变更，让团队明确如何处理更新。

从编辑选型角度看，需要共享责任信息和跨项目可见性的团队值得进一步研究 Asana。对审批或保密行为有明确要求时，应使用准备购买的套餐验证对应路径。本文没有实际测试或确立账户创建、集成、通知时间、离线行为或合同托管权利。
